easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, giving Ingenious Artillerist the Pirate creature type until end of turn.
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ingenious Artillerist triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Ingenious Artillerist is a Pirate due to Unnatural Selection, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Ingenious Artillerist triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Ingenious Artillerist trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 4.
